assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Project asset for a beginner IT educational course, not a full illustration. Create one photorealistic, neutral unbranded desktop monitor, isolated with true transparent background. Exact straight-on orthographic front view at eye level, absolutely level, symmetrical physically plausible thin matte charcoal bezel and a simple single silver metal central stand on a broad stable thin silver foot. Screen aspect ratio 16:10, screen is completely blank solid very pale blue #eef3f7, no reflection obscuring it. Monitor body occupies most of image width and upper 75 percent of image height, stand underneath, small balanced transparent margin all around. Soft studio light from upper left, realistic subtle materials and soft shadow immediately under foot, clean high quality product photo. No computer tower, no keyboard, no mouse, no cable, no desk, no logos, no text, no UI, no icons, no symbols. Geometry must be easy to overlay a separate flat rectangular HTML window on the screen. One monitor only.
